note: Static form-state pseudo-classes (corpus/form-controls): :checked, :disabled and :enabled match from the element's attributes (Selectors §6.6.2/§6.6.4 for a static renderer) — proved by sibling combinators feeding author color to labels of a checked checkbox, a checked radio, a disabled input, an enabled input, and a div carrying a disabled attribute which must NOT match :disabled (divs are not enableable; Chrome leaves its label black and so must the engine).
